user.title: Pair with Hotel TV
user.description: In the Hotel TV admin open **Настройки → Home Assistant** (Settings → Home Assistant) and press **Генерирай код** (Generate code). Enter the server address shown there and the code. The code is valid for 10 minutes and works once.

data_description.url: The address you open the Hotel TV admin at, for example http://192.168.1.20:3210

reauth_confirm.title: Pair {property} again
reauth_confirm.description: Hotel TV no longer accepts this Home Assistant for {property} (the connection was removed, or this entry was made before pairing existed). Generate a new code in **Настройки → Home Assistant** on {url} and enter it here. The controls chosen for the TVs are kept.

reconfigure.title: Change the Hotel TV server
reconfigure.description: Change the server address, for example after it moved, and pair again: generate a new code in **Настройки → Home Assistant** on the server. It must be the same property.

error.invalid_url: This is not a valid web address.
error.insecure_url: Use https://, or an address in the local network (a private IP address or a .local / .lan name).
error.invalid_code: The code is wrong or was already used. Generate a new one.
error.expired_code: The code has expired (it is valid for 10 minutes). Generate a new one.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
error.unreachable: The Hotel TV server could not reach Home Assistant. Check Home Assistant's local network URL (Settings → System → Network) and that the server can reach it.
error.no_ha_url: Home Assistant has no URL the server could use. Set the local network URL in Settings → System → Network.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Hotel TV server. Check the address.
error.not_hotel_tv: The server answered, but not like a Hotel TV server that supports pairing. Check the address and update Hotel TV.

abort.already_configured: This property is already connected. It has been paired again with the new code.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The server address has been changed.
abort.wrong_property: That code belongs to another property. Generate the code for this property.
abort.other_property_updated: That code belongs to {property}; its entry has been paired again instead. Generate a code for this property to pair it.

init.title: TV controls
init.description: Guests can control some of the room's devices with the TV remote. Choose them per TV. A TV also gets the entities the hotel bound to it in the Hotel TV admin.

menu_options.map_tv: Choose the entities of a TV

map_tv.title: TV controls
map_tv.description: Choose a TV to pick what its guests may control. A ✓ shows how many entities the TV already has.

tv_entities.title: {tv}
tv_entities.description: Choose the thermostats, lights, switches, covers, scenes, fans, locks and media players the guest may control from the TV {tv}. Entities bound to this TV in the Hotel TV admin are added to these. Choose none to add nothing here.

tv_labels.title: Names on the TV: {tv}
tv_labels.description:
The TV shows each entity under its Home Assistant name. Type a different name where you want one, or leave the field empty.

{entities}

fill_pattern.title: Fill other TVs by pattern
fill_pattern.description: Choose a TV that is already set up. For every other TV the integration looks for the same entities with the number in that TV's name in the entity id (for example TV 203 → TV 204: `climate.room_203_thermostat` → `climate.room_204_thermostat`) and copies the names shown on the TV. You see what was found before anything is saved.

data.overwrite: Also replace TVs that already have entities

data_description.overwrite: Off: only TVs with nothing chosen yet are filled.

fill_confirm.title: Save the found entities?

abort.not_loaded: The integration is not loaded or the property has no TVs. Try again when it is connected.
abort.no_mapped_tvs: No TV has entities yet. Choose the entities of one TV first.

error.nothing_found: No matching entities were found for the other TVs. The entity ids must contain the number in the TV's name (for example its room number), and TVs that already have entities are skipped unless you choose to replace them.

auth_failed.message: Hotel TV no longer accepts this Home Assistant. Pair again with a new code.

pairing_required.message: This entry was made with an API token. Pair it with a code from Настройки → Home Assistant.

cannot_connect.message: Could not connect to the Hotel TV server ({error}).

not_a_tv.message: {target} is not a TV of Hotel TV.

no_tvs.message: Choose at least one TV (a Hotel TV device or one of its entities), or turn on "All TVs".

entry_not_loaded.message: The Hotel TV property {entry} is not loaded.

no_entries.message: No Hotel TV property is connected.

send_message.name: Send message
send_message.description: Shows a message on the chosen TVs, or on every TV.

display.name: Display
display.description: A banner, a window, or the full screen.

expires_in.name: Expires in
expires_in.description: Hide the message after this long. Empty = until it is deleted.

all_tvs.name: All TVs
all_tvs.description: Send to every TV of the property (when no TV is chosen).

config_entry_id.name: Property
config_entry_id.description: With "All TVs": only this property. Empty = every connected property.

send_command.name: Send TV command
send_command.description: Sends a raw command to the chosen TVs.

payload.name: Payload
payload.description: Parameters of the command, for example {"number": 5} for set_channel or {"volume": 30} for set_volume.

refresh_channels.name: Refresh channels
refresh_channels.description: Re-checks the channel sources and reloads every TV.

config_entry_id.name: Property
config_entry_id.description: Only this property. Empty = every connected property.

wait.name: Wait for the result
wait.description: Wait until every source is checked (10–90 s) and return the probe result. Off = start the refresh and return at once; the TVs reload when it is done.
